resources.string: The Flatpak version runs sealed off from your system, so it starts games only through a launcher's link, such as steam://rungameid/620. It cannot pick or run programs and game folders on this computer; the .deb and AppImage versions can.
The Flatpak version can only start this game through a launcher's link, such as steam://rungameid/620. Edit the game and enter one.
